title: Grok Build remote settings (GET /v1/settings)
description: Informational schema — tracks the `RemoteSettings` struct as of SOURCE_REV 9b8d35b46d959c042ea9aa31cbbebbd1f0c5c527. Server-controlled payload fetched from cli-chat-proxy `GET /v1/settings`; NOT a user-authored config file. Every field is `Option`/`Vec` with `#[serde(default)]`, so nothing is required, unknown keys are tolerated, and `null` deserializes to `None`. Several nested values use tolerant deserializers that coerce wrong types to `None` rather than failing the parse; those fields are described as permissive here. Numeric clamps document the client-honored range (the resolver clamps out-of-range values).

leader_mode.description: When `Some(true)`, the server recommends enabling leader mode; fallback when `[cli] use_leader` is unset locally.

max_upload_file_bytes.description: Max per-file upload size in bytes.

max_upload_untracked_bytes.description: Max aggregate untracked upload size in bytes.

non_git_workspace_capture.description: When `Some(true)`, capture workspace files for non-git project dirs (client default: off).

login_shell_capture.description: Whether to capture the login shell environment.

scheduler_background_loops.description: When `Some(false)`, scheduled task fires run as main-conversation turns instead of background subagents.

release_channel.description: Release channel; documented values `"stable"` | `"alpha"`. Plain `Option<String>` — any string is accepted by serde (unknown values fall back at the resolve site), so no `enum` constraint. Fallback when no local `[cli] channel` or `--alpha`/`--stable` flag is set.

loc_tracking.description: When `Some(true)`, enable LOC attribution tracking for this session.

memory_enabled.description: Enable the experimental memory system remotely.

memory_search_max_results.description: Max results returned by memory search.

memory_search_min_score.description: Minimum similarity score for a memory search hit (f32; typically a 0.0-1.0 score, not clamped at parse time).

memory_initial_injection_enabled.description: Whether to inject top memories at session start.

memory_initial_injection_min_score.description: Minimum score for initial memory injection (f32; typically a 0.0-1.0 score, not clamped at parse time).

memory_embedding_model.description: Embedding model id for memory vectors.

pruning_keep_last_n_turns.description: Number of most-recent turns pruning always keeps.

flush_soft_threshold_tokens.description: Token threshold that triggers a soft flush.

flush_idle_timeout_secs.description: Idle seconds before an automatic flush.

flush_semantic_dedup_threshold.description: Similarity threshold for semantic dedup on flush (f64; typically a 0.0-1.0 score, not clamped at parse time).

memory_temporal_decay_enabled.description: Enable temporal decay weighting of memories.

memory_temporal_decay_half_life_days.description: Half-life in days for temporal memory decay (f64).

memory_mmr_enabled.description: Enable Maximal Marginal Relevance reranking on memory retrieval.

memory_mmr_lambda.description: MMR lambda trade-off (f64; typically a 0.0-1.0 weight, not clamped at parse time).

subscription_watch_interval_secs.description: Cadence (seconds) of the pager's free-to-paid subscription watch; `0` disables it (pager clamps and defaults).

oauth2_issuer.description: OAuth2 provider issuer URL (e.g. "https://auth.x.ai"); paired with `oauth2_client_id`.

oauth2_client_id.description: OAuth2 client_id for the CLI; paired with `oauth2_issuer`.

grok_oauth_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, enable grok's default OAuth2 (xAI auth.x.ai); `--oauth` CLI flag overrides.

folder_trust_enabled.description: Folder-trust gate kill-switch / remote default (gates repo-local MCP/LSP servers). `Some(false)` is a kill-switch; `None` falls back to client default (on).

file_toolset.description: File toolset; documented values `"standard"` | `"hashline"`. Plain `Option<String>`, arbitrary strings accepted; local `[toolset] file_toolset` takes precedence.

inference_idle_timeout_secs.description: Per-chunk idle timeout (seconds) for inference streaming; fallback when no per-model value is set.

mcp_startup_timeout_secs.description: Global default MCP startup-handshake timeout (seconds), lowest-precedence fallback.

max_mcp_output_bytes.description: Global default MCP tool-result inline cap (bytes); built-in default 20000, overridden by requirements/env/config.

session_registry_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, enable session registry hooks; absent/`Some(false)` disables all (default: disabled).

doom_loop_recovery.description: Doom-loop recovery settings object; absent ⇒ every knob falls through to TOML/defaults, a partial object falls through per-field.

worktree_auto_gc.description: Automatic worktree GC policy. Present-but-malformed nested value is dropped to `None` (tolerant deserializer, does not fail the whole `RemoteSettings` parse).

todo_gate_enabled.description: Enable/disable the runtime turn-end TodoGate remotely; ships disabled. Precedence: CLI `--todo-gate` > this > default false.

todo_gate_max_fires_per_prompt.description: Hard cap on TodoGate fires per user prompt; no CLI override.

goal_enabled.description: Enable goal mode remotely; `Some(false)` is a kill-switch; absent ⇒ client default (enabled).

goal_classifier_enabled.description: Enable the goal-completion classifier; absent ⇒ tracks goal mode.

goal_planner_enabled.description: Enable the goal planner; absent ⇒ tracks goal mode.

goal_summary_enabled.description: Enable the goal summarizer (closing summary on a verified achievement); `Some(false)` kill-switch; absent ⇒ tracks goal mode.

goal_verifier_count.description: Number of adversarial skeptics per goal-verification attempt; clamped to 1..=5 at the resolver (client-honored range encoded here). Absent ⇒ harness default (3 today).

goal_classifier_max_runs.description: Max per-goal classifier runs before auto-pause; floored at 1 at the resolver with deliberately no upper ceiling, so remote may raise it arbitrarily. Absent ⇒ harness default (10 today).

goal_strategist_every.description: Fire the stall-triggered strategist every N consecutive NotAchieved verifications; clamped to >= 1 at the resolver. Absent ⇒ max(1, goal_classifier_max_runs / 2).

goal_planner_model.description: Planner role model+harness pair. Tolerant deserializer: a present-but-malformed value (or explicit null) is dropped to `None` rather than failing the parse, so real servers may send other shapes; the well-formed object shape is modeled here. Absent ⇒ inherit current model.

goal_strategist_model.description: Strategist role model+harness pair. Tolerant deserializer (malformed/null ⇒ `None`). Absent ⇒ inherit current model.

goal_skeptic_models.description: Ordered skeptic model pool (skeptics 1..N assigned round-robin). Tolerant deserializer: a non-array value (or null/absent) yields an empty pool and each malformed entry is dropped; survivor order is preserved. Well-formed entries modeled here.

managed_mcps_enabled.description: Remote fallback for managed MCP connector fetching.

external_otel_disabled.description: Fleet kill-switch for the external OTEL stream (customer collectors); tighten-only.

external_otel_content_gates_locked.description: Force the external stream's content gates off regardless of local env/config; tighten-only.

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry mode override; documented values `"session-metrics"` | `"full"` | `"off"`. Plain `Option<String>`, arbitrary strings accepted; takes precedence over `telemetry_enabled` when present.

two_pass_compaction_enabled.description: Two-pass (prefire) compaction; `Some(true)` enables, `Some(false)` forces off, `None` falls back to local config/env/default (off).

tips.description: Dynamic tip list; one is shown at startup (rotated daily by UTC day). `None` or `[]` = no tips.

additionalProperties.description: Tag label rendered as a bracketed suffix in the slash dropdown. Intended string; tolerant — a non-string entry degrades the WHOLE map to `None`.

slash_command_tags.description: Free-form per-command dropdown tags (e.g. `new`, `beta`), keyed by canonical slash-command name. Tolerant deserializer: a present-but-malformed value — a non-object, or an object with any non-string entry — is ignored, degrading to `None` with a warning rather than failing the whole `RemoteSettings` parse. Keys are the open command-name space and values are free-form labels, so neither carries an `enum`. Lowest tier of the merge: local `[slash_command_tags]` overrides remote per key (surviving remote keys are kept), and `GROK_SLASH_COMMAND_TAGS` overrides both.

non_git_warning.description: Controls the non-Git-repo warning at session start; `Some(false)` is a kill-switch; `None` falls back to `[features] non_git_warning`.

official_marketplace_auto_register.description: Gate for first-run auto-registration of the official xAI marketplace source; `None` falls back to env/default (off).

plugin_cta.description: Gate for the inline plugin-install CTA (keyword-matched marketplace upsell); `None` falls back to env/default (off).

announcements.description: Remote announcements list. Tolerant deserializer: malformed items are skipped; a non-array value ⇒ `None`. `None` or `[]` = nothing to display.

web_search_model.description: Model id used for web search.

session_summary_model.description: Model id used for session summaries.

image_description_model.description: Model id used to describe images.

prompt_suggestion_model.description: Server-side pin for the next-prompt suggestion model (tab-autocomplete ghost text); catalog-guarded at use.

default_model.description: Server-recommended default model id for new sessions.

campaigns.description: Remote `campaigns[]` overlays: each an `id` gate plus a flattened config patch. Plain `Vec<CampaignOverride>` with `#[serde(default)]` — absent key ⇒ empty list.

auto_background_on_timeout.description: When `Some(true)`, foreground commands that hit the default timeout are auto-backgrounded; fallback for `[toolset.bash] auto_background_on_timeout`.

allow_background_operator.description: When `Some(false)`, foreground commands containing a background `&` operator are rejected; absent ⇒ client default (allow).

ask_user_question_timeout_enabled.description: Fallback for `[toolset.ask_user_question] timeout_enabled`; when `Some(false)`, questionnaires wait forever unless a higher tier sets otherwise.

ask_user_question_timeout_secs.description: Fallback for `[toolset.ask_user_question] timeout_secs` (positive seconds); absent ⇒ client default (1800).

subagent_worktree_snapshot_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, a completed subagent's isolated worktree is snapshotted into a durable git ref; absent ⇒ disabled (ships dark).

image_gen_enabled.description: Gate for the `image_gen` tool; `Some(false)` hides it, absent ⇒ env / `[features] image_gen` / client default (on). Listing the tool in `imagine_tools_disabled` force-disables it regardless.

image_gen_model_override.description: Optional Imagine model override for `image_gen`; absent/empty ⇒ default quality model.

image_edit_model_override.description: Optional Imagine model override for `image_edit`; absent/empty ⇒ default model. Lowest tier of `resolve_image_edit_model_override`: env `GROK_IMAGE_EDIT_MODEL_OVERRIDE` > `[features] image_edit_model_override` > this.

video_gen_enabled.description: Gate for the `video_gen` tool pair; `Some(false)` hides it, absent ⇒ env / `[features] video_gen` / client default (on). Listing `image_to_video`/`reference_to_video`/`video_gen` in `imagine_tools_disabled` force-disables it regardless.

image_normalize_cache_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, enable the process-wide image normalize cache; default disabled.

path_not_found_hints.description: When `Some(true)`, enrich path-not-found errors with CWD reminders and "did you mean?" corrections.

contextual_hints.description: Remote enable tier for per-tip contextual hints; each field is a soft default (absent/null ⇒ client default on). User config beats this tier.

worktree_type.description: Server-recommended worktree creation type; fallback when no local `[cli] worktree_type` is set.

restore_code.description: Server-recommended default for `restore_code` in worktree resume; fallback for local `[cli] restore_code`.

cancel_rewind_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, Ctrl+C before first server activity rewinds the prompt back into the input box instead of cancelling the turn.

session_recap.description: Enables the session recap feature (`/recap` + automatic return-from-away); remote kill-switch, shell defaults ON when unset.

ask_user_question_enabled.description: Enables the `ask_user_question` tool; `Some(false)` strips it, `Some(true)`/absent ⇒ shell default (ON).

web_fetch_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, enable the `web_fetch` tool; absent/`Some(false)` ⇒ not registered.

web_fetch_proxy.description: Egress proxy endpoint for the web_fetch tool; fallback for local `[toolset.web_fetch] proxy_endpoint`.

web_fetch_allowed_domains.description: Domain allowlist for the web_fetch tool; fallback for local `[toolset.web_fetch] allowed_domains`.

show_resolved_model.description: When `Some(false)`, hide the resolved model id in /session-info.

sharing_enabled.description: When `Some(true)`, enable session sharing; absent/`Some(false)` ⇒ disabled.

voice_mode_enabled.description: Voice mode (STT dictation); client default on when absent, `Some(false)` is a remote kill-switch.

zdr_access_enabled.description: Whether ZDR (Zero Data Retention) users may use the product; default false (blocked) during beta.

privacy_notice_rollout.description: Cohort gate for the coding-data sharing upsell banner on the welcome screen; the resolver substitutes `false` when absent/null, so older servers and missing flags keep the banner hidden. Env `GROK_PRIVACY_NOTICE_ROLLOUT` overrides.

privacy_banner_reshow_days.description: Days after a privacy-banner dismiss before it may re-show for users who remain coding-data opted-out. `None` and `0` are handled identically — the consumer filters on `days > 0`, so both mean never re-show after dismiss. Env `GROK_PRIVACY_BANNER_RESHOW_DAYS` overrides.

remember_tool_approvals.description: Tier of the `remember_tool_approvals` gate (whether per-tool "Always allow …" options show); default false.

crash_handler_enabled.description: Tier of the crash-handler install gate; lowest precedence, default off, `Some(false)` is a kill-switch.

show_thinking_blocks.description: Whether the TUI shows agent thinking/reasoning blocks; `None` defers to local/env/default (true), `Some(false)` is a kill-switch.

group_tool_verbs.description: Whether the TUI folds consecutive non-destructive tool calls into one row; `None` defers to local/env/default (true), `Some(false)` is a kill-switch.

collapsed_edit_blocks.description: Whether the TUI shows Edit tool calls as a collapsed diffstat and merges back-to-back edits; `None` defers to local/env/default (false), `Some(false)` is a kill-switch.

display_refresh.description: Display-refresh probe + auto-cadence settings; a partial object falls through per-field.

auto_mode.description: Raw remote JSON for the `[auto_mode]` table (gate `enabled`, `prompt_type`, `classifier_model`); coerced into the shell's typed `AutoModeConfig`. Field is `Option<serde_json::Value>`, so ANY JSON value (object/scalar/array/null) is accepted.

permission_mode.description: Soft default permission mode; documented values `"ask"` | `"auto"` | `"always-approve"` | `"default"`. Plain `Option<String>`, arbitrary strings accepted; used only when no effective TOML permission key is set.

subscription_tier.description: User's subscription tier from `grok_build_access_gate`; stamped on analytics + user profile. Plain `Option<String>`.

session_picker_grouped.description: Whether the session picker groups entries by repo name; `Some(false)` ⇒ flat list, absent ⇒ client default (grouped).

allow_access.description: Whether the user may use Grok Build (set by `grok_build_access_gate`); `None` = no server response yet, `Some(false)` = blocked.

subscription_tier_display.description: User-friendly display name for the subscription tier. Plain `Option<String>`.

on_demand_enabled.description: Whether on-demand credit usage is enabled; when `Some(false)`, on-demand cap changes are blocked.

usage_billing_redirect_url.description: When non-empty, `/usage` shows a link to this URL instead of fetching billing data; `None`/empty keeps default behavior.

suggestions_enabled.description: Enable the shell command suggestion pipeline remotely.

suggestions_ai_enabled.description: Enable AI-powered shell command suggestions remotely.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description: Global auto-compact threshold percent from `grok_build_settings`. Field is `u8` so serde accepts 0..=255 (maximum 255 encoded); the value is a percentage (semantically 0-100). Per-model override, user config, and env further override.

system_prompt_label.description: Global system-prompt identity label; per-model override wins.

compaction_wall_clock_budget_secs.description: Global per-compaction wall-clock budget (seconds); `0` disables. Env override applies.

compaction_mode.description: Compaction mode; documented values `"summary"` | `"transcript"` | `"segments"`. Plain `Option<String>`, arbitrary strings accepted; env and user config override.

compaction_detail.description: Segments verbatim detail; documented values `"none"` | `"minimal"` | `"balanced"` | `"verbose"`. Plain `Option<String>`, arbitrary strings accepted; env and config override.

compaction_verbatim_input.description: Verbatim-input flag; env and config override; `None` = default (true).

imagine_tools_disabled.description: Denylist of optional imagine tools to disable (e.g. ["image_edit"]); a listed tool is authoritatively removed and local env/config can't re-enable it.

workspace_command_enabled.description: Gate for the `grok workspace` CLI command (Computer Hub workspace exposure); `Some(true)` enables, `None`/`Some(false)` keep it off.

jemalloc_heap_profile_enabled.description: Master switch for jemalloc heap sampling + threshold dumps; `Some(false)` kill-switch, `None` = client default off.

jemalloc_heap_profile_thresholds_bytes.description: Resident-byte thresholds (u64 items, e.g. 2G/5G/10G as byte counts); `None` and `[]` are distinct on the wire.

jemalloc_heap_profile_poll_interval_secs.description: Stats poll interval in seconds when set.

doomLoopRecoverySettings.description: Doom-loop recovery settings (one struct for local `[doom_loop_recovery]` TOML and remote `doom_loop_recovery` JSON); all fields optional with per-field defaults.

enabled.description: Send the doom-loop-check header and parse reported triggers; `Some(false)` is a kill-switch, absent ⇒ client default (off).

max_threshold.description: Highest tail_repetition threshold considered confident; clamped to 2..=64 (client-honored range encoded here). Absent ⇒ client default 8.

max_retries.description: Resample budget per turn; clamped to 0..=5 (client-honored range encoded here). Absent ⇒ client default 2.

worktreeAutoGcSettings.description: Local `[worktree.auto_gc]` / remote `worktree_auto_gc` policy. Field-wise tolerant deserialize (a bad key cannot drop a sibling kill-switch); wrong-typed scalar fields coerce to `None` and are never a parse error, so each scalar is permissive here.

enabled.description: `Some(false)` kill-switch; absent ⇒ default on. Intended bool; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None` (never rejected).

max_age_secs.description: Age cutoff seconds when platform age-expiry is allowed; clamped by resolver. Intended non-negative integer; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

min_interval_secs.description: Min seconds between successful auto-GC stamps; clamped by resolver. Intended non-negative integer; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

dry_run.description: Count age candidates without deleting. Intended bool; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

include_orphan_snapshots.description: Linux only. Intended bool; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

max_age_by_kind.description: Per-kind max ages. Recognized keys: `session`/`ab`/`pool`/`fork`/`manual`/`subagent` (unknown kind keys are accepted then ignored at resolve). Tolerant: a non-object whole value coerces to `None`; a per-entry invalid value is silently dropped. Each value is seconds, `"never"`, or null.

include_rebuild.description: Optional discovery rebuild + stale `.git/worktrees/` prune (default off). Intended bool; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

rebuild_min_interval_secs.description: Independent rebuild throttle seconds; absent ⇒ 24h. Intended non-negative integer; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

worktreeKindMaxAge.description: Per-kind age policy for auto-GC: non-negative integer seconds, the literal string `"never"`, or null (⇒ Never). Hand-written visitor also accepts a numeric string and case-insensitive "never"; the server only ever emits a u64 number or `"never"`.

goalRoleModel.description: A model + harness `agent_type` pair; the atomic configurable unit (a model is only guaranteed to work with a compatible harness). Both fields are required strings for a well-formed value.

model.description: Model id, e.g. "grok-4"; resolved against available models at spawn time (unknown/unauthorized ⇒ fail-open to current model).

agent_type.description: Harness `agent_type` (e.g. "cursor", "grok-build-plan") whose AgentDefinition decides the role subagent's harness flavor; resolved by name, fails open before commit.

contextualHintsRemote.description: Remote enable tier for per-tip contextual hints (mirrors the client's `[ui.contextual_hints]` shape); each field is a soft default, `None` defers to the client default (on).

undo.description: Undo tip (Ctrl+Z after a substantial draft wipe).

send_now.description: Send-now tip after queuing a mid-turn follow-up (InterjectPrompt chord).

small_screen.description: Small-screen tip (`/compact-mode` hint on smallish terminals).

ssh_wrap.description: SSH wrap session-load tip (recommend `grok wrap ssh` for remote sessions).

displayRefreshSettings.description: Display-refresh probe + auto-cadence settings (one struct for local `[ui.display_refresh]`, remote `display_refresh`, and `UiConfig`). Field-wise tolerant deserialize (wrong types ⇒ `None`); unknown keys are preserved in a flatten `extra` catch-all, so `additionalProperties` are kept. Client defaults: probe on, auto off, floor 8ms, ceiling 16ms, Hz band 55-165.

probe_enabled.description: Once-per-process primary-display Hz probe; `Some(false)` is a kill-switch. Intended bool; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

auto_cadence_enabled.description: Derive paint/scroll cadence from a successful probe (default off). Intended bool; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

floor_ms.description: Lower clamp for auto-derived ms (default 8). Intended u32; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

ceiling_ms.description: Upper clamp for auto-derived ms (default 16). Intended u32; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

min_hz.description: Minimum accepted probe Hz for auto-cadence (default 55). Intended u32; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

max_hz.description: Maximum accepted probe Hz for auto-cadence (default 165). Intended u32; tolerant — wrong types coerce to `None`.

campaignOverride.description: A remote `campaigns[]` entry: an `id` gate plus a full-power flattened config patch (the JSON sibling of a `[[campaigns]]` TOML override). The patch is a flatten catch-all, so arbitrary sibling keys are expected (`additionalProperties` kept).

campaign_id.description: Alias for `id` (`#[serde(alias = "campaign_id")]`); both spellings deserialize into the same field.

remoteAnnouncement.description: Announcement from remote settings or local override; every field is optional and tolerant (malformed items are dropped by the parent list deserializer).

id.description: Stable announcement id (used as the hide key).

dismissible.description: Whether the user may dismiss the announcement.

persistent.description: Whether the announcement persists across sessions.

announcementCta.description: Optional call-to-action on an announcement (clients render it as a clickable link/button); the server only emits it with both fields non-empty and the url https, kept tolerant here.

caption.description: Optional dim helper text after the button; absent = none.
